gaps: Setting specific auction configuration options like auction_config: rank directly in add_rfq_round is not supported by the available body fields.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and no rounds.
steps: The buyer adds a pricing (RFQ) round to the event with the value 10, with the bid start time moved later, with the bid end time moved later.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that “status” is present.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “status” is present.
